prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Choose Your Pet's Style", "Select Pet Style Base"]
1: ["Your Pet is Live on Your Desktop", "Use quick hotkeys or right-click your pet anywhere on screen to open options.", "Quick Desktop Pet Controls", "Learn how to interact with your pet on screen before finishing setup.", "Press Alt+P to hide or reveal pet; right-click to chat.", "Got It"]
2: ["Configuring Desktop Permissions", "Ensuring display overlay access so your pet renders correctly on top of active windows.", "Desktop Window Overlay Granted"]
3: ["Choose How Your Desktop Friend Lives", "Pick Companion Style"]
4: ["Use the same auth provider on all devices to avoid resetting your active pet sync.", "Data Reset Prevention Enabled"]
5: ["Use well-lit front photos (PNG/JPG under 10MB) to prevent distortion in pet rendering.", "High Resolution Recommended"]
6: ["Register Desktop Pet Identity", "Pet Name", "Your pet certificate will be attached to this desktop."]
7: ["An audio chime will alert you when your pet lands on your desktop."]
8: ["Give Your Pet Their First Treat!", "Your pet has spawned on your desktop. Click below to feed them their starter treat.", "Give Starter Treat"]
9: ["Step 1 of 4: Select your desktop pet journey."]
